why: Expected decoded-frame digests for the camera-original clips. Their sources are copyrighted trailers that this repository does not carry, so the built clips live only under build-upscaling/ and the manifest that describes them is not tracked either. These digests are, which is what lets a clean checkout prove that a rebuild produced the same pixels the committed labels in tools/benchmark/corpus.py were verified against. A mismatch means the upstream re-encoded, not that the labels are wrong - re-verify before citing them.
